sources.snippet: This project relies on recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and large language models (LLM) to address that problem, and builds on earlier NSF efforts that created a publicly available large language model to study inter- and intra-state conflict, called ConfliBERT (Hu et al., 2022).

sources.snippet: To help advance research in political science, we introduce ConfliBERT, a domain-specific pre-trained language model for conflict and political violence. We first gather a large domain-specific text corpus for language modeling from various sources. We then build ConfliBERT using two approaches: pre-training from scratch and continual pre-training.
